text:
Asking rents in Augsburg stand at a median of 14.09 €/m² (2026-06), up 4.4% on the year and +28.1% over five years. That ranks Augsburg #9 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 66% above the 2022 average contract rent of 8.48 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 845 € a month in cold rent, 19.9% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 24 days and 27% are gone within a week; with 2.1% market-active vacancy and +2.8% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 14.94 €/m² (+6.0%), with an 80% range of 14.57 to 15.32 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
